cameraInstructions: Film from the side with the shoulder, elbow, wrist, hip, and ankle visible for the whole movement.

metrics.targetText: Keep the shoulder, hip, and ankle in one straight line.
metrics.hint_good: Your body stayed connected in one strong line.
metrics.hint_high: Your hips moved away from the body line. Brace your stomach and keep the hips level.

metrics.targetText: Reach a bottom elbow angle of about 70-105 degrees.
metrics.hint_good: You lowered to a strong, controlled depth.
metrics.hint_low: You lowered very deep. Use a slightly smaller range and keep the shoulders controlled.
metrics.hint_high: The push-up was shallow. Bring your chest a little closer to the floor.

metrics.targetText: Finish each push-up with the arms nearly straight.
metrics.hint_good: You finished the push-up with strong arm extension.
metrics.hint_low: Push a little higher and straighten the arms before the next repetition.
metrics.hint_high: Keep the arms straight without forcing the elbows past a comfortable position.

metrics.targetText: Reach a similar depth on each push-up.
metrics.hint_good: Your push-ups reached a similar depth.
metrics.hint_high: The depth changed between push-ups. Choose a range you can repeat with control.

metrics.targetText: Keep the same strong body line throughout every push-up.
metrics.hint_good: Your body line stayed stable across the movement.
metrics.hint_high: Your hips became less stable between push-ups. Keep bracing your core as you get tired.
